title: Singing tempo at wakes and Rene playing blues for churches
summary: Wake singing was slow, blues-like; Rene played blues for spiritual churches and discusses tricky hymn tempos.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
